name: Decision dialog help
description: Help mode entries for the decision dialog: the one pop-up for everything waiting for your decision.
author: Brett

entries.title: Decision dialog settings
entries.text: Which kinds of decision pop up on your screen and which send a notification, how long Later waits, and what is waiting for you now.

entries.title: Decisions waiting for me
entries.text: Opens the newest decision waiting for you in the decision dialog, over the screen you are on.

entries.title: Approve
entries.text: Approves this item as it is. For UI Review it marks the item approved and the build goes on.

entries.title: Approve as is
entries.text: Approves the item without picking one of its options.

entries.title: Request changes
entries.text: Asks for changes: type what should change and tap Send. The note goes to the build.

entries.title: Reject
entries.text: Rejects the item; the build is held until it is fixed and sent again.

entries.title: Later
entries.text: Puts the pop-up away for a while (15 minutes unless you change it). It stays in the queue and the counter.

entries.title: Open in UI Review
entries.text: Goes to the UI Review page. Only this button navigates; the dialog itself never takes you away from your screen.

entries.title: Previous decision
entries.text: Several decisions are waiting: shows the one before this one.

entries.title: Next decision
entries.text: Several decisions are waiting: shows the next one.

entries.title: Pops up
entries.text: On: this kind of decision opens the dialog by itself on whatever screen you are on. Off: it waits in the queue only.

entries.title: Notifies
entries.text: On: a notification (bell, AmberX phone) when this kind of decision arrives.

entries.title: Later waits
entries.text: How many minutes Later keeps a decision from popping up again.

entries.title: Check now
entries.text: Reads the queue again right away.

entries.title: Show
entries.text: Opens this waiting decision in the dialog.

entries.title: Send
entries.text: Sends your note with the answer.

entries.title: Pick option
entries.text: Chooses this option: the item is approved with this option as the one to build. Voice: "pick option 2".
